Ghostscript WebAssembly - Corresponding Source

Runtime version: Ghostscript 10.08.0
Package: ghostscript-wasm 10.8.0
License: GNU AGPL v3 or later

The accompanying ghostscript-wasm-source.tar.gz contains the
Ghostscript source tree, WebAssembly build script, JavaScript
wrappers, package metadata, and the documented source modifications
used by this Ghostscript WebAssembly distribution.

This source is provided to accompany the Ghostscript WebAssembly
runtime distributed in the parent directory.
